astra.act1.battery_built.text: Heating online! We reuse leftover machine heat, just like Perseverance.

astra.act1.drone02_wake.text: Drone two is awake! Now we can build two rooms together.

astra.act1.end.text: Great teamwork this week! Next, let's grow food and explore.

astra.act1.first_dusk.text: Outside can reach about minus eighty degrees Celsius tonight. Watch our Heat bar.

astra.act1.first_sleep.text: Good morning! Bedroom rest restored twelve health points.

astra.act1.first_sunset.text: Look, a blue sunset! Fine Mars dust scatters the sunlight.

astra.act1.heat_warning.text: Our base is losing heat. Let's reroute the warm pipes.

astra.act1.repair_kit_ready.text: Repair Kit ready! Drag it onto drone two's dusty joints.

astra.act1.storm_begin.text: The storm is here! Mars dust storms can cover the whole planet.

astra.act1.storm_end.text: The storm is over! Let's clean that sticky Mars dust.

astra.act1.storm_mid.text: Dust blocks most sunlight. Every bit of saved power helps.

astra.act1.workshop_built.text: Workshop ready! Let's make a Repair Kit for drone two.

astra.act1.workshop_start.text: Let's build the Workshop so we can make our own parts.

astra.act2.blackbox_home.text: The black box is home! We need the Comms Lab to read it.

astra.act2.drone03_wake.text: Drone three is awake! All three builders are ready to help.

astra.act2.end.text: Wonderful teamwork! Next, let's build the Lab and unlock Pathfinder's mystery.

astra.act2.first_harvest.text: Our first lettuce harvest! Fresh food now restores some energy each Sol.

astra.act2.garage_built.text: Rover ready! Drive carefully; sharp Mars rocks damaged Curiosity's wheels.

astra.act2.garage_start.text: Drone two is building our Garage and Airlock for Rover trips.

astra.act2.greenhouse_built.text: Greenhouse ready! We grow in nutrient water, avoiding harmful salts in Mars soil.

astra.act2.greenhouse_start.text: Drone one is building our Greenhouse for fresh food.

astra.act2.map_intro.text: Tap a glowing map spot to send our Rover exploring.

astra.act2.pathfinder_found.text: We found Pathfinder! Its black box holds clues; its antenna could fix our Lab.

astra.act2.reboot_kit.text: Reboot Kit ready! We reused the old weather probe's power core.

astra.act2.surface_warning.text: Outside, radiation adds up over time. Let's keep trips short.

astra.act3.blackbox_decode_start.text: Code unlocked! Let's hear Pathfinder's last log.

astra.act3.blackbox_react1.text: A thump every thirty-seven minutes! Quakes don't usually keep a schedule.

astra.act3.blackbox_react2.text: Curiosity detected methane too! It can come from life or reactions between water and rocks.

astra.act3.deep_scan.text: Our scan suggests salty water below the canyon. Salt lowers water's freezing temperature.

astra.act3.final_prep.text: Our Rover and suit are ready! Let's find the Jezero Signal.

astra.act3.lab_built.text: Comms Lab ready! Light takes about three to twenty-two minutes between Mars and Earth.

astra.act3.lab_start.text: Pathfinder's antenna fits! Drone one is building our Research and Comms Lab.

astra.act3.ls_t2.text: Life Support upgraded! We extract oxygen from Mars air, like Moxie did.

astra.act3.radiation_lesson.text: Soil shielding reduces radiation around our rooms and Rover, but some still gets through.

astra.act3.rec_built.text: Recreation room ready! Games and music help our crew feel at home.

astra.act3.roof_built.text: Roof finished! Thick soil blocks most radiation, but some still gets through.

astra.badge.first.text: Your first badge! It celebrates skills real astronauts use.

astra.branch.ready.text: Good planning! Our equipment check is complete; the waiting route or upgrade has reopened.

astra.branch.repaired.text: Nice work! The Workshop repaired our setup, so its extra checks can stop.

astra.branch.upkeep.text: Our earlier choice needs another equipment check. Let's finish its repair task.

astra.char.bumble.text: Drone two checks everything carefully. Let's call it Bumble!

astra.char.pip.text: Happy beeps! Let's call drone one Pip.

astra.char.zip.text: Drone three is quick! Let's call it Zip.

astra.choice.d1a.callback.text: Our Power Saver choice still saves power, but careful work makes fewer parts.

astra.choice.d1b.callback.text: Tilting our panels helped save parts. Regular wipes keep that setup working.

astra.choice.d1c.callback.text: Studying our drained batteries helped research, but leaves less workshop time.

astra.choice.d2a.callback.text: Our filter repairs saved water! Keeping spare filters ready takes workshop time.

astra.choice.d2b.callback.text: Our Cargo Trailer brings more scrap, but cleaning its cargo uses extra water.

astra.choice.d2c.callback.text: Our water rationing plan saved water, but grows less food.

astra.choice.d3a.callback.text: Our potato tests helped research, but took growing space. Soil washing remains available.

astra.choice.d3b.callback.text: Our washed soil beds grew extra food, but keeping this trial going uses water.

astra.choice.d3c.callback.text: Our extra hydroponic trays grew more food, but their lamps need more power.

astra.choice.d4a.callback.text: Keeping our plants warm grew extra food, but leaves less power for research.

astra.choice.d4b.callback.text: Earth's advice helped our research, but working with those messages uses extra power.

astra.choice.d4c.callback.text: Kitchen warmth saved power! Our drone keeps moving trays for this plan.

astra.choice.d5a.callback.text: Our lighter travel plan saved parts, but shorter trips bring less loose scrap.

astra.choice.d5b.callback.text: Our cliff shelter map helped research. Covered stops reduce exposure, but make trips longer.

astra.choice.d5c.callback.text: Collecting longer behind Rover shielding brought extra parts, but also more radiation exposure.

astra.choice.e1a.callback.text: Practising our shelter plan saved supplies, but preparation leaves less workshop time.

astra.choice.e1b.callback.text: Working through the flare made extra parts. Let's keep checking our suit seals.

astra.choice.e1c.callback.text: Our shelter forecast helped research! A drone keeps checking our warning equipment.

astra.choice.e2a.callback.text: Our dust devil maps revealed collecting spots with more scrap, but more effort outside.

astra.choice.e2b.callback.text: Stowing our panels saved repair power, but our sheltered setup collects less sunlight.

astra.choice.e2c.callback.text: Careful panel tilts brought extra power! Regular wipes keep that setup working.

astra.choice.e3a.callback.text: Fixing our leak saved air, but spare seals take workshop time.

astra.choice.e3b.callback.text: Our tape patch saved time for collecting parts, but still needs regular valve checks.

astra.choice.e3c.callback.text: Our airlock checks saved water, but checking before each trip takes longer.

astra.choice.exp2.60a.callback.text: Our careful Pathfinder route helped research and reduces exposure, but takes longer.

astra.choice.exp2.60b.callback.text: Our direct Pathfinder route found collecting spots with more parts, but more exposure.

astra.choice.exp3.85a.callback.text: Our extra ice survey saved water, but processing those cores still uses power.

astra.choice.exp3.85b.callback.text: Our lighter crater trips saved power, but bring less loose scrap.

astra.coop.role_missing.text: You can still do this without that specialist; it just takes longer.

astra.d1.a.text: Smart thinking! Saving power helped us through the storm.

astra.d1.alert.text: A dust storm will block most sunlight for three Sols. How should we prepare?

astra.d1.b.text: We charged our batteries before the storm, with some radiation exposure outside.

astra.d1.c.text: The storm drained our batteries. Next time, let's save power beforehand.

astra.d2.a.text: Water first! Our recycler recovers ninety-eight percent again, like the space station.

astra.d2.alert.text: Our recycler filter cracked. We have parts for a filter or a Cargo Trailer.

astra.d2.b.text: Our trailer helps collect more parts, but the broken filter still wastes water.

astra.d2.c.text: Using less water helped, though everyone felt tired. Space station astronauts take sponge baths too.

astra.d3.a.text: Good experiment! The plants absorbed harmful salts, so we test before eating.

astra.d3.alert.text: Could we grow potatoes in Mars soil? Let's think it through.

astra.d3.b.text: Rinsing removes many harmful salts from soil, but some can remain.

astra.d3.c.text: Careful thinking! Testing first is what real scientists do.

astra.d4.a.text: Our plants stayed warm! Our next radio slot is in three Sols.

astra.d4.alert.text: Tonight, we have power for Greenhouse heating or our Earth message. Which comes first?

astra.d4.b.text: Earth's message cheered everyone up! Our chilly plants are growing more slowly.

astra.d4.c.text: Clever thinking! We kept plants warm using heat we already had.

astra.d5.a.text: We came home with fewer samples, but we can return for more.

astra.d5.alert.text: A solar storm is coming! How should our Rover crew shelter?

astra.d5.b.text: Thick rock reduces radiation, like the soil above our base.

astra.d5.c.text: Our shielding reduced radiation, but couldn't block everything. Let's rest after collecting those samples.

astra.e1.a.text: We're sheltered! A huge solar storm reached Mars in May, twenty twenty-four.

astra.e1.alert.text: Solar flare! How should we use our underground shielding?

astra.e1.b.text: Working meant more radiation exposure. Next time, let's shelter first.

astra.e1.c.text: Good planning! Drones handle radiation better than people, but storms can disrupt them too.

astra.e1.watch.text: The Sun has a stormy spot facing Mars. A flare could come soon.

astra.e2.a.clean.text: The dust devil cleaned our panels, as sometimes happened to Spirit and Opportunity.

astra.e2.a.dusty.text: The dust devil left more dust. Let's wipe our panels.

astra.e2.alert.text: A dust devil is coming! It might clean our panels or add dust.

astra.e2.b.text: Stowed panels are better protected from dust, but make less power.

astra.e2.c.text: Our cleaning worked! Keep trips short, since radiation adds up outside.

astra.e3.a.text: Found the leak! Space station crew once tracked one with a floating tea leaf.

astra.e3.alert.text: Our airlock is leaking oxygen and water vapor. Let's find the leak.

astra.e3.b.text: Tape helps for now, but we'll need a lasting repair soon.

astra.e3.c.text: Closing the airlock stops the leak while our drone works.

astra.e4.a.text: Nice care! Scott Kelly nursed space station flowers back to health too.

astra.e4.alert.text: Our plants need balanced nutrient water to grow food. Let's check the mix.

astra.e4.b.text: Fresh water helped! The plants should recover by tomorrow.

astra.e4.c.text: Our plants need help now; their water supplies the minerals their roots need.

astra.exp1.return.text: The weather probe's power core still works! Let's use it to wake drone three.

astra.exp3.return.text: Our scan found buried ice! Each Ice Core gives us twenty-five water units.

astra.exp4.at20.text: That's Ingenuity! The first helicopter on another planet made seventy-two flights.

astra.exp4.at35.text: Jezero once held a lake. Its delta could hold clues to ancient life.

astra.f1.alert.text: Tilting helped charge our batteries, but dust reached the motor mount. Let's choose a solution.

astra.f2.alert.text: Our Cargo Trailer's extra scrap needs balancing before another Scrap Run.

astra.f3.alert.text: Our untreated soil test needs its own tray before we expand.

astra.f4.alert.text: Our extra hydroponic lamps share a heat pipe. Let's choose how to adjust them.

astra.f5.alert.text: Keeping plants warm delayed our call. Let's choose a canyon route plan.

astra.f6.alert.text: Earth sent a canyon map! Let's check it against our scans.

astra.f7.alert.text: Our shelter plan worked! Let's choose how to care for our forecast sensor.

astra.f8.alert.text: Our tape patch needs attention again. Let's choose our next repair step.

astra.finale.closing.text: Real scientists ask these questions too. Maybe you'll help answer them someday!

astra.finale.home.text: Wonderful work, Commander! Our rebuilt base helped us discover possible clues to ancient life.

astra.finale.leopard.text: Perseverance found similar spots at Cheyava Falls. They're clues to possible ancient life, not proof.

astra.finale.methane.text: Methane might come from rock reactions or ancient microbes. We need more clues.

astra.fit.critical.text: Low fitness is affecting your health. Let's choose the Recover plan.

astra.fit.intro.text: Exercise keeps bones and muscles strong. Space station astronauts exercise about two hours daily.

astra.fit.low.text: Exercise helps make work and trips easier. Add an exercise hour to your Sol Plan.

astra.fit.mars.text: Mars gravity is thirty-eight percent of Earth's. We're still studying its effects on muscles.

astra.fit.rec_open.text: Our Recreation room has exercise equipment! Your workouts count double now.

astra.hp.25.text: Your health is low. Rest and fresh food help restore energy.

astra.hp.50.text: Your health is at half. Let's plan some Bedroom rest.

astra.hp.full.text: Your health is fully restored! Ready for our next adventure.

astra.hp.medrest_end.text: Your health is back to fifty. Fresh food helps restore more energy.

astra.hp.surface_70.text: Radiation adds up outside. Let's keep this trip short.

astra.hp.zero_base.text: Time for medical rest until tomorrow. Our drones and I will keep things running.

astra.hp.zero_expedition.text: A rescue drone will bring you and some supplies home for rest.

astra.intro.landing.text: Welcome to Ares One in Jezero Crater! I'm Astra, your station friend.

astra.intro.status.text: Our Bedroom, Kitchen and Life Support work. Our solar panels need cleaning.

astra.intro.why_underground.text: Our underground base has thick soil shielding. It blocks most radiation, but some gets through.

astra.jobs.intro.text: While our drones build, open Jobs and choose a way to help!

astra.lives.danger_food.text: Empty Food costs our Commander energy. Let's check the Greenhouse.

astra.lives.danger_heat.text: Empty Heat costs our Commander energy. Let's fix the heat pump.

astra.lives.danger_oxygen.text: Empty Oxygen costs our Commander energy. Let's fix the air scrubber.

astra.lives.danger_water.text: Empty Water costs our Commander energy. Let's check our water supply.

astra.lives.rewind.text: Good try! Let's revisit our last decision while the rescue team takes over.

astra.logbook.first.text: Your first Science Logbook card! We collect real facts as we explore.

astra.mg.air_filter_scrub.text: Spacesuits carry dust indoors. Clean filters help keep it out of our lungs.

astra.mg.dish_antenna_alignment.text: Aim our dish carefully; radio messages need about three to twenty-two minutes to reach Earth.

astra.mg.heat_pump_reroute.text: Let's send leftover machine heat through pipes, like Perseverance does.

astra.mg.nutrient_match.text: Our plants grow without soil, so their water must supply minerals.

astra.mg.solar_wipe.text: Static makes Mars dust cling to panels. Let's wipe it away.

astra.mg.suit_seal_check.text: Mars air is too thin to breathe. Let's check our suit seals.

astra.mg.valve_balance.text: Our scrubbers remove carbon dioxide, the gas we breathe out.

astra.mg.water_sort.text: The space station recovers ninety-eight percent of used water. We still need replacement ice.

astra.mg.wheel_pebble_vacuum.text: Sharp Mars rocks damaged Curiosity's wheels. Let's clean and check ours.

astra.plan.crunch.text: Crunch builds faster, but tires our crew. Let's use it sparingly.

astra.plan.no_free.text: Everybody needs a break, even on Mars. Let's make some free time.

astra.plan.short_sleep.text: Less sleep means more work time, but more tiredness. Let's protect our rest.

astra.plan.unlock.text: Astronauts plan their day. Tap your portrait to see your Sol Plan.

astra.rad.partial_room.text: This roof isn't finished. Some radiation gets through, so let's keep visits short.

astra.rad.rover_shield.text: Our Rover's new soil bricks reduce radiation, but don't block it all.

astra.rad.suit_liner.text: Our new suit liner reduces radiation using materials rich in hydrogen.

astra.report.intro.text: Here's our mission report, Commander. Every choice taught us something.

astra.report.outro.text: Scientists write mission reports too. What shall we try next time?

astra.res.emergency_worry.text: Our crew is worried about the emergency. Let's work on repairs.

astra.res.food_low.text: Food stores are low. Let's check our Greenhouse plants.

astra.res.heat_zero.text: Our pipes are freezing. Let's reroute the heat pump.

astra.res.morale_low.text: Our crew could use a boost. Recreation or a message from Earth would help.

astra.res.oxygen_low.text: Oxygen is low. Let's check our air scrubbers, which clean the air.

astra.res.oxygen_zero.text: Let's move into the Bedroom; its backup air tanks will help.

astra.res.power_zero.text: Only life support has power now. Let's clean our solar panels.

astra.res.storage_save.text: Our spare supplies helped! I've opened the emergency stores.

astra.res.water_low.text: Our recycler loses a little water each day. Let's plan an Ice Run.

astra.sandbox.milestone_50.text: Fifty Sols on Mars! Your careful work keeps our base going.

astra.sandbox.random_tip.text: Need water or parts? Ice Runs and Scrap Runs are always repeatable.

astra.sandbox.start.text: Free play is open! Keep building and exploring; I'll be here.

astra.t2.battery.text: Deep Cell Bank charged! More stored power helps us stay warm overnight.

astra.t2.garage.text: Our upgraded battery lets the Rover travel farther. More exploring ahead!

astra.t2.greenhouse.text: Our upgraded farm stacks growing trays for more food in the same room.

astra.t2.lab.text: Deep Space Array online! We can spot storms early and scan underground.

astra.t2.rec.text: A Mars rock on display! Beautiful things help our crew feel at home.

astra.t2.solar.text: Our new panels have brushes and a tilt motor to help manage dust.

astra.t2.workshop.text: Precision Fabricator ready! Now we can make two things each Sol.

astra.tut.build_prompt.text: Tap the Battery and Heating frame, then Build. Drone one will help.

astra.tut.done.text: Great start! A Sol is a Mars day, about thirty-nine minutes longer than Earth's.

astra.tut.drone01_click.text: Drone one's battery is empty. Let's clean our dusty solar panels first.

astra.tut.drone01_prompt.text: Drag the charged battery into drone one's back hatch, then snap the cable in.

astra.tut.drone01_wake.text: Drone one is awake! Let's give our builder a job.

astra.tut.hp_intro.text: This bar shows health and energy. Sleep and fresh food restore energy.

astra.tut.solar_done.text: Panels working! Mars gets less than half Earth's sunlight, so clean panels matter.

astra.tut.solar_prompt.text: Let's wipe our solar panels clean; static makes Mars dust sticky.
